answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The prism graph is validated at intake and the plume frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and ocean anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 30 percent of the vote must hold 12 percent of the bonded float for 12 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
